$comment: The published pipeline explainer (workbuddy.link/p/q2roJSMji6XoVFqndZsfw9) is a fourth copy of the pipeline description — next to the skill, the README, and the ADRs. The other three live in the repo and are covered by gates; this one is edited through an upload API, has no owner here, and nothing failed when it kept describing a transport the repo had already retired. It did exactly that after ADR 0007: still '三条传输' with a fork-loop card a full day after the code was deleted, noticed only because a human happened to look. This file is the record of the last time someone verified the page against contracts/transports.json, and scripts/explainer-page-gate.mjs fails when the registry moves without the page being re-verified. The `observed` block is written by `--sync` from the live artifact, never by hand. Note that `artifactUrl` carries a version directory that advances on every publish, so re-syncing passes `--url` with the current one.
